ORAL ORDER 3 09-04-2025 Heard Mr. Brajesh Sahay representing the appellant and Ms. Ashmita Bharti representing the Central Bureau of Investigation.

2. The present appeal has been filed:
against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence both dated 12.02.2025 passed in Special Case No. 96 of 2011 (CIS No. 2232/2014), arising out of R.C. No.
40/A/91 by Sri Avinash Kumar, Special Judge, CBI-I, Patna; wherein the appellant has been convicted for offences punishable under sections 120B read with 420, 420 and 409 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 [hereinafter referred to as 'IPC for brevity]
and for section 13(1)(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act [hereinafter referred to as 'PCA' for brevity].
Accordingly, he has been sentenced for rigorous imprisonment of three years and fine of Rs. 50,000/-, for each Patna High Court CR.

APP (SJ)
No.1068 of 2025(3) dt.09-04-2025 offence, with direction to undergo additional 3 months simple imprisonment upon non- payment of fine of every offence.
All the sentences are directed to run concurrently.

Also, learned trial court has pleased to enlarge the appellant on P. K. Singh @ Pankaj Kumar Singh vs The Central Bureau Of Investigation on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2155326/
1 provisional bail for the period of two months by order dated 12.02.2025.
3. Admit.
4. Call for the Trial Court Record from the Court of learned Special Judge, CBI-I, Patna in connection with Special Case No. 96 of 2011 (CIS No. 2232/2014), arising out of R.C. No. 40/A/91.
5.

8. List this case in usual course.
